author: Francisco Angulo de Lafuente
status: Exploratory analysis of already-seen routing corpus; plan fixed before this new calculation, not before data collection

training_weights.mixed_reference: Each training request has unit weight
training_weights.code_only: Only training-fold code requests, each with unit weight
training_weights.balanced_code_general: Half code mean distribution plus half non-code mean distribution

capacity: All candidate profiles retain the mixed reference slots per layer in every fold
evaluation: Reuse exact published folds; full-fold exclusion; score all45requests, bothcohorts and all4domains; equal request weighting; report every result; no winner selection
diagnostic: Zero percentage-point mean static coverage tolerance in each code/non-code cohort; also list every regressing original domain. This is not a runtime promotion gate or a statistical population claim.
limits: Static fixed-trace coverage only: no measured speed, generated-answer quality or adaptive-cache benefit.
The corpus and original domain results were known when this exploratory follow-up was planned.
No GPU run, model load, runtime update, automatic selection or rollback is performed.
The pre-existing live-pilot parity/improvement gate remains failed and unchanged.
A runtime promotion requires separately fixed code and non-code quality and latency criteria, live measurements and an agreed scope.

amendments.change: Correct literal domain label STEM to stem to match the frozen manifest. Initial run stopped at the domain-count assertion before computing comparisons. Counts, profiles, folds, budget and diagnostics unchanged.

After first scoring, normalize pinned text-input checksums to LF for Windows/Linux portability. Only input-hash validation changed; profile choices, folds, quotas and metric calculations unchanged. All metric output sections must match the retained first results exactly.

input_hash_format: SHA-256 of text input bytes after CRLF to LF normalization
